correctness.rationale: The identity C=2(I+sL)^{-1}-I reduces the signed update to diagonal resolvent returns. The degree-regularized nonnegative adjacency matrix has exactly Delta ports per node and convergent Neumann series. Unique lifting of tree walks into its port walk system proves the coefficientwise return comparison, with strictness for finite graphs. A Schur complement computes the exact Delta-tree diagonal Green function and identifies the half-return root (2Delta-1)/(2Delta(Delta-1)); bounded dominated convergence on regular-tree balls proves sharpness for every higher s. Normalizations and endpoint quantifiers were checked; the standalone rational checker passed 771 connected labelled graphs and tree-ball counterexamples, supplementary rather than substitute evidence.

value.rationale: A natural network-wide maximum-degree condition has an exact dimension-free timestep frontier and finite sharpness witnesses. This resolves a worst-case positivity design question over every graph topology, improving the diagonal sufficient condition s≤1/Delta by an explicit sharp factor, and explains why regular-tree local geometry is extremal. The contribution is not a finite-table recomputation or the known general positivity identity.
